name: Grocy
description: Track groceries with barcodes and best-before dates, chores, batteries, recipes and meal plans. ERP beyond the enterprise.
compose:
services:
  grocy:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/grocy:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:80"
    environment:
      PUID: "1000"
      PGID: "1000"
      TZ: "UTC"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/config
    restart: unless-stopped
